item.rrce.control_point_add_tool.tooltip: Marks _rail ends_ to lay out a railway route.
When right-clicking a track or block
_Add a rail end_ after the selected one. The direction you look sets its forward direction.
item.rrce.control_point_select_tool.tool: _Select_ that end. Repeated clicks cycle through ends in the same block.
item.rrce.control_point_move_tool.toolti: Adjusts the position of the selected _rail end_.
rrce.ponder.survey.text_1: Right-click with the Add Control Point Tool to mark a rail end. Your view sets its direction.
rrce.ponder.survey.text_2: Add another point to complete a section. New points go after the selected point.
rrce.ponder.survey.text_3: Right-click a control point with the Select Tool. Repeated clicks cycle points in the same block.
rrce.ponder.survey.text_4: Right-click a new location with the Move Tool to move the selected point.
rrce.ponder.survey.text_5: The Direction Tool turns the selected point by 45 degrees. Sneak-right-click to turn the other way.
rrce.ponder.survey.text_6: Right-click with the Remove Tool to delete the selected point.
rrce.ponder.plan.text_1: Two rail ends define a section. The plan extends it to parallel tracks with the chosen spacing.
rrce.ponder.plan.text_2: Right-click the Construction Plan to choose the number of lines, clear spacing, rail material and foundation.
rrce.ponder.plan.text_3: Preview the entire roadbed before building. This example uses two lines with three empty blocks between them.
rrce.ponder.plan.text_4: Construction places a full-width foundation, then both tracks. The roadbed also reaches both ends.
rrce.ponder.plan.text_5: Undo restores the area before construction. Redo builds the same railway again.
rrce.ponder.cut.text_1: When an obstacle stays below the tunnel threshold, construction cuts through it.
rrce.ponder.cut.text_2: The cut exposes the full roadbed and slopes upward only to its sides, not beyond the rail ends.
rrce.ponder.cut.text_3: Set the slope angle and obstacle threshold in the Construction Plan.
rrce.ponder.tunnel.text_1: When terrain rises above the threshold, construction bores a tunnel instead.
rrce.ponder.tunnel.text_2: The tracks pass through a square tunnel. With zero side clearance, the walls border the roadbed.
rrce.ponder.tunnel.text_3: The plan controls clearance, wall thickness and wall material. Server terrain rules decide what may be dug.
